ambiguity_policy: Dense normalization and lasso mapping are two independently inspectable requested changes in one source. One card can cover both only when its actual quote expresses both, not merely because its source ID matches. The modal question and inline suggestion are treated as one design-choice request with alternatives, not two required implementation changes. The PSLab future-work invitation could be read as an optional general testing suggestion, but is not labelled a current-PR action; report this counter-reading if emitted. Earlier author replies before a later reviewer request are not acceptable, even if their topic overlaps. A specific later author explanation can be relevant without proving correctness.
